w1/intro: Ten characters and five opening battles. Rome is raided, the defending champion is grounded, and an axe misses by 0.68. Everything that follows starts here.
w2/intro: The pickle takes a throne, the champion answers back, and the axe finally lands. One team gets a new name and a new address: Despair.
w3/intro: Rome wins for the first time and the mech loses for the first time. The storm follows one manager to a motel, and Casello is the last unbeaten team.
w4/intro: Someone finally leaves Despair, and someone else gets the bill. Casello moves to 4-0, and the AI survives the storm by 1.80.
w5/intro: Casello reaches 5-0, the Executioner wins a fourth straight, and Rome becomes a file in an archive. Two losing streaks reach four.
w6/intro: Casello survives by 3.14 to stay perfect. The Executioner makes it five in a row and puts out the Eternal Flame. Their collision is set for next week.
w7/intro: The unbeaten run ends with an axe through the mission table. Elsewhere the gods abandon Rome, a pirate checks into a resort, and a homemade mech beats the future.
w8/intro: Four teams finish 6-2 and the throne stays empty. The storm breaks the axe, a train is intercepted, an empire is sold, and one long losing streak finally ends.
w9/intro: All four leaders win again and stay level at 7-2. The axe is reforged, the vault holds, and a bridge to the fortress stops one span short. Nobody blinks.
w10/intro: Every game this week was a rematch of Week 1. Three losers got even, two winners did it again, and the four-way tie at the top is over. Three teams hold the battlements at 8-2, with Casello one step below.
w1/m1/title: Everything's for Sale. Except the Win.
w1/m1/recap: In a smoky back room, a trade negotiation goes nowhere. Phil has already won, and the pile of rejected offers says so.
w1/m2/recap: A clean military operation forces the defending champion's storm bird out of the sky. Still powerful, but on the ground.
w1/m3/recap: In a rain-soaked stadium the mech is leaking and barely upright when the axe comes down. It misses by 0.68.
w1/m4/recap: The machine stays calm while a pickle-science operation collapses around it. A 74.06-point margin turns the catchphrase inside out.
w1/m5/recap: A black-and-silver raiding force storms a Roman coastal fortress and walks out over broken shields and fallen standards. It is still the Rangers' signature win.
w2/m1/recap: A night storm tears through Phil's rooftop lounge. The champion rebounds, and Phil is left soaked among the overturned furniture.
w2/m2/recap: A convoy rolls through a ruined roadside town without stopping. The sign reads: Welcome to Despair. Population: jvarsam.
w2/m3/recap: The Executioner walks into a data center and cuts the cables. Emergency lights flash, the machine powers down, and he leaves dragging the axe.
w2/m4/recap: The Rangers raid an industrial shipyard and meet the mech defending it. Their gear is left among the cranes and containers.
w2/m5/recap: The pickle storms the emperor's palace and takes the throne, with a centurion's helmet for a crown. The catchphrase is back, with the week's high score behind it.
w3/m1/recap: A raid on Phil's back-room operation, finished with professional calm. Third mission complete, on fewer than 92 points.
w3/m2/recap: Bags packed under the awning of the Despair Motel, waiting for a way out. The storm bird lands on the roof instead.
w3/m3/recap: A close one, 3.56 points, that ends the way they have been ending. The pickle puts up a fight and becomes another name on the list.
w3/m4/recap: Roman engineers haul the beaten mech into an imperial foundry. It is the empire's first win and the machine's first loss.
w3/m5/recap: The Rangers attack an AI-run city and its defenses see every move coming. 177.98 is the biggest score of the early season.
w4/m1/recap: Phil is at the head of a long table when the Executioner arrives with the bill. It is a large bill.
w4/m2/recap: Sunrise at the Despair Motel. He walks out with his luggage, past the wreck of a mech in the parking lot. A first win, by 82.42.
w4/m3/recap: The storm hits a hydroelectric dam while the AI works the emergency controls. The dam holds by 1.80.
w4/m4/recap: Modern armor rolls through the streets of a captured Roman city. Four missions, four completed.
w4/m5/recap: A pirate ship is overrun by laboratory machinery. Its black-and-silver banner joins the collection, floating in green brine.
w5/m1/recap: A late-night repair garage, a mech that barely runs, and an invoice for Phil. Balance due: 2.38.
w5/m2/recap: He had checked out of Despair. The Executioner checks in anyway, and wins by 90.54.
w5/m3/recap: A lightning-capture machine almost works. Then the containment overloads and the storm bird bursts out through the laboratory.
w5/m4/recap: On a military airfield, a transport plane unloads confiscated Ranger gear. The mission board gets a fifth green check.
w5/m5/recap: A Roman library becomes a data archive. Helmets, banners and scrolls are scanned and filed as the records of a defeated civilization.
w6/m1/recap: Phil tries to turn his season around at a poker table. Across from him sits a machine that already knows his hand.
w6/m2/recap: A new construction firm breaks ground, starting with a wrecking ball through a pickle laboratory. The boss sleeps through it.
w6/m3/recap: The pirate fleet sails into a storm. The bird dives, lightning splits the mast, and the flagship goes under.
w6/m4/recap: The mech smashes through a mountain checkpoint to the last gate, where steel cables stop it 3.14 short. The perfect record survives.
w6/m5/recap: The Executioner reaches the chamber of Rome's Eternal Flame and cuts the chain. The brazier falls and the flame goes out.
w7/m1/recap: Phil stars in his own comeback movie with a pickle directing. The stunt explosion goes off early and the production is cancelled.
w7/m2/recap: A shipwrecked captain crawls ashore at the Rest & Rebuild Resort. Staff bring a towel. The owner does not get up.
w7/m3/recap: The last legionaries retreat to a mountain temple and pray to Jupiter. The storm bird lands on the statue.
w7/m4/recap: The Executioner storms the command bunker and puts the axe through the mission table. Six green checks, then the first red X.
w7/m5/recap: A homemade mech walks into a robotics exhibition. The future, it turns out, is not automated.
w8/m1/recap: Two long losing streaks and one closing gate in the Losers' Maze. Phil squeezes under it by 3.98.
w8/m2/recap: The Roman Empire goes to auction. A sleeping paw lifts a paddle at the wrong moment. Final sale, no refunds.
w8/m3/recap: The Executioner is steps from the throne when the roof gives way. Lightning hits the axe and shatters it. The streak ends at six.
w8/m4/recap: An armored train on a classified route pulls into a station the AI already controls. Mission 8: intercepted.
w8/m5/recap: The mech's claw lifts what is left of the laboratory and carries it to the scrapyard, with its owner still clinging on.
w9/m1/title: The Thrill Is Back. Rome Isn't.
w9/m1/recap: Confetti, a microphone and a wrestling ring. Phil celebrates 85.56 like a title while the last centurion sits against the ropes.
w9/m2/recap: The bridge to the championship fortress needs one last section when the machinery shuts off. It stops 2.34 short.
w9/m3/recap: The mech breaks down at a mountain gas station in the rain. The storm bird watches from the roof and never has to move.
w9/m4/recap: A pickle nearly makes it out of the treasury with the goods. Then the vault door closes, and the commander is back to winning.
w9/m5/title: The Axe Was Broken. The Executioner Wasn't.
w9/m5/recap: At a mountain forge, the Rangers attack before the reforged axe has cooled. It holds. So does he.
w10/m1/recap: Phil is in his chair in the back room where he won in Week 1 when the wall comes down behind him. The permit is approved, the new owner is asleep on his feet outside, and the comeback ends at two.
w10/m2/recap: Back at the airfield that grounded it in Week 1, the storm bird takes off and the aircraft are the ones that cannot fly. The mission board takes a third red X.
w10/m3/recap: The same rain-soaked stadium where the axe missed by 0.68. This time the reforged blade lands in the mech's shoulder, and the old debt is settled by 14.26.
w10/m4/recap: The pickle's biggest machine yet was in pieces on the hologram before he threw the switch. His 131.46 is the most points anyone lost with all week.
w10/m5/recap: The Rangers return to the Roman coast and plant the black flag on a city wrapped in scaffolding and Sold banners. It is their first win since Week 1, over the same opponent.
team/1/avatar: A veteran Roman centurion: bronze and steel helmet with a tall red crest, segmented armor, a crimson cloak and a legion shield.
team/1/origin: Commander of a proud red-and-gold empire sworn to Victory Without End.
team/1/arc: Through Week 10: Rome has been raided twice, occupied, archived and sold at auction, and its Eternal Flame is out. He still stands like a soldier.
team/1/nemesis: Go Go Bower Rangers!, who started the collapse by sacking Rome in Week 1.
team/2/avatar: A helmeted pirate captain in black and silver football-style armor under a torn longcoat, cutlass in hand.
team/2/origin: Captain of a raiding fleet that opened the season by conquering Rome.
team/2/arc: Through Week 10: eight failed raids in a row, a sunk fleet and a stay in the Losers' Maze. Then a second sack of Rome, and the first win since Week 1.
team/2/nemesis: Sunday Scaries, whose storm sank the flagship in Week 6.
team/3/avatar: A towering hooded executioner in scratched dark armor and a torn crimson cloak, with red eyes under the hood and an enormous two-handed axe.
team/3/origin: Lost Week 1 by 0.68 points when the axe just missed, then went hunting.
team/3/arc: Through Week 10: six straight wins, the Eternal Flame put out and Casello's perfect record ended. The axe was shattered, reforged, and finally settled the 0.68-point miss from Week 1.
team/3/nemesis: Sunday Scaries, whose lightning broke the axe.
team/4/avatar: A colossal storm bird wreathed in lightning. It does not speak and does not need to.
team/4/origin: The defending champion, back to keep the crown.
team/4/arc: Through Week 10: grounded in Week 1, then six straight wins, with a fleet sunk, a temple claimed, an axe shattered and the airfield that grounded it left dark.
team/4/nemesis: Sunday Executioners, ever since the night in the trophy hall.
team/5/avatar: A modern field commander in camouflage and a plate carrier, helmet under one arm. Calm and unreadable.
team/5/origin: Treats every matchup as a mission and files the paperwork afterward.
team/5/arc: Through Week 10: six missions, six completed. Since then, three red X marks in four weeks and a step down from the battlements.
team/5/nemesis: Sunday Executioners, who put the first red X on the board.
team/6/avatar: A huge bald man in a plain navy T-shirt and blue jeans, usually with a cigar and always with something to say.
team/6/origin: Back-room boss, movie star and wrestling champion, in his own telling.
team/6/arc: Through Week 10: won big in Week 1, lost six straight, escaped the Losers' Maze and celebrated beating Rome like a title. Then the back room was sold out from under him.
team/6/nemesis: The Picklers, who directed his comeback film straight into an explosion.
team/7/avatar: A living pickle and mad scientist, surrounded by glowing brine and inventions that are about to explode.
team/7/origin: Says "It's too easy!" after every win. The league now says it back after every loss.
team/7/arc: Through Week 10: took Rome's throne and pickled a pirate ship. Since then the laboratory has been short-circuited, demolished and towed away, the vault job failed, and the AI saw the newest machine coming.
team/7/nemesis: Laggys Mean Machine, which hauled the laboratory off as scrap.
team/8/avatar: A welder in a flipped-up helmet at the controls of a towering rust-colored mech built from excavators and scrap.
team/8/arc: Through Week 10: survived the axe by 0.68, was wrecked at the Despair Motel, then flattened a robotics expo and towed a laboratory. The axe finally caught up with it.
team/8/nemesis: ChatGPG. Polished technology against a machine held together by welds.
team/9/avatar: A sleek white and silver humanoid AI with glowing blue eyes. It treats every matchup as an optimization problem.
team/9/origin: The machine that predicts everything, most weeks.
team/9/arc: Through Week 10: archived Rome, won at the casino, intercepted a military train, left a bridge one span short and predicted a pickle's best machine. Its one blind spot was a homemade mech.
team/9/nemesis: Laggys Mean Machine, the variable it did not compute.
team/10/avatar: A giant, sleepy builder in a yellow hard hat who wins without waking up.
team/10/origin: Started the year as Willing to Trade, then spent a month stranded in Despair, population one.
team/10/arc: Through Week 10: checked out of the Despair Motel, opened a construction firm and a resort, bought the Roman Empire by accident, and took over Phil's back room.
team/10/nemesis: Sunday Executioners, who followed him back to the motel.
